x8370983804.title: Al-Kabir Awy 2
x8370983804.description: The story of two twin brothers; one who was raised in the USA and the other who is the mayor of the village of Mazarita. Upon their dad's death, the American brother comes back for his inheritance and position as mayor too, and comical events unfold.

xbcd88c6efb.title: Captain Azouz
xbcd88c6efb.description: The events of the comedy animated series continue in the third season, with the adventures of Captain Azouz, his crew, and his aunt as they sail the world with their boat. They present a new tale in a different place, with many funny situations happening to them.

xe2dc26ef24.title: Layaly Al-Helmiya 1
xe2dc26ef24.description: The events revolve around the conflict between Selim Al-Badry and Mayor Soliman Ghanem, and how Nazik Al-Salhdar benefits from this conflict to serve her own goals. As Soliman tries to avenge his father, who died in prison because of Selim's father, Soliman buys shares in Selim's textile factory.

x7ba4c2a5a1.title: Zohra wa Azwag'ha Al-khamsa
x7ba4c2a5a1.description: Zohra's beauty attracts an unimaginably large number of suitors. Her kindheartedness and love for all those who approach her lead her into trouble when she finds herself married to five men at the same time.

x9f20503469.title: Altaasiea
x9f20503469.description: The talk show program on Egyptian Channel 1 is concerned with reviewing the most important local and international news and events, in addition to hosting stars in the fields of art and sports.

xb39979c411.title: Sabah El Khair Ya Masr
xb39979c411.description: One of the most famous morning programs that provides interactive services, such as opinion polls and viewer participation on many important issues raised in Egypt.

xbd4646669e.title: صلاة الجمعة
xbd4646669e.description: يجتمع المسلمون في جميع أنحاء العالم للدعاء لله تعالى وأداء صلاة الجمعة في مساجد مختلفة.

mv1138359.title: عربي
mv1138359.description: سلسلة ويب رائدة يتناول فيها صناع الأفلام من العالم العربي عملية صناعة الأفلام.
